ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Bludgeon.cs:17-20) == cost 3 / ATTACK / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY. No keywords, no tags.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(32m, ValueProp.Move)` (Bludgeon.cs:15) == `_damage = 32`, dealt with the default `DamageProps.CARD` (MOVE, powered) -- matching prop sets.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.Damage.BaseValue).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (Bludgeon.cs:25-29) == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.resolve_target(target_idx), self._damage, dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. Single hit, no follow-up effect, no liveness guard on either side. Presentation, folded in: WithAttackerAnim / WithHitFx / WithHitVfxSpawnedAtBase and the Ironclad heavy-anim helpers select animations only.

guards.rationale: AnyEnemy cards always resolve a target; `ctx.resolve_target(target_idx)` is the sim's equivalent contract.
